products.name: Holistic AI
products.note: Bias auditing, risk management, compliance; strong technical depth; mid-market focus

reading.body:
Holistic AI addresses a gap between AI deployment speed and organizational visibility. The company builds tools to find every AI system in use across an organization, test them for safety and bias, and maintain compliance with multiple regulatory frameworks, positioning itself in a market where AI scaling outpaces governance infrastructure.

The platform's scope reflects a real problem in large enterprises: AI systems proliferate faster than IT teams can track them. Shadow AI, undocumented deployments, and fragmented ownership create risk that neither traditional software governance nor manual auditing can contain. Holistic AI's approach of automated discovery, continuous testing, and real-time monitoring for agentic systems addresses the operational side of this constraint. As organizations deploy more AI systems, governance tools become part of the cost structure for scaling safely.

This data does not reveal adoption rates, deployment timelines, or whether the platform materially affects how fast enterprises can actually build and deploy AI. It also does not cover whether governance tools themselves become a constraint on AI scaling, or whether they primarily reduce risk within existing deployment patterns. The company's stated focus on mid-market organizations suggests a gap between what enterprises need and what they can currently afford or implement at scale.

profile_text.body:
Holistic AI is a London-based enterprise software company that describes itself as a provider of an end-to-end AI governance platform. Its platform is designed to give organizations visibility and control over their AI portfolios by automatically scanning cloud platforms, code repositories, and SaaS applications to identify every AI system in use, including shadow AI, and maintaining a continuously updated inventory of those systems classified by risk level, owner, lifecycle stage, and business purpose.

The company's core product, also called Holistic AI, sits in the AI governance and risk management category and combines discovery, testing, monitoring, and compliance functions in a single tool. Testing capabilities include AI red teaming with adversarial testing, jailbreak resistance, prompt injection detection, and more than 40 AI and ML test types covering performance, robustness, explainability, and safety. The platform includes built-in frameworks for the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and NYC Local Law 144, with automated control mapping and gap analysis. The company also describes a supervisory layer for agentic AI that monitors behavior and intervenes in real time when risk thresholds are crossed. Quoted customers include Unilever and MindBridge.

Industry analysts referenced on the company's site include Everest Group, CB Insights, Avasant, and Forrester, each of which is described as recognizing Holistic AI for its governance platform or ranking it among notable AI companies. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations appear in the available data.
